Why this matters

Being seen is the whole game now.

You are looked up before you are met. Before the call, before the pitch, before anyone walks into a room. What they find is either you, thinking, or it is nothing.

And a founder's time is the one thing there is never more of. That is why this always stops. Not because the intent was wrong, but because week three arrives, there is something on fire, and posting is what gives.

Having the time would not be enough either. Knowing what is worth saying, saying it so people stay to the end, cutting it so it looks like something. That is a separate craft, and it is not the one you are paid for.
